title: RedProposal
description: One bounded benign workflow variation proposed by the Red role. A proposal ONLY: it must never contain execution results, Splunk matches, labels, or an acceptance verdict.

contract_version.description: Semantic version of this red_proposal contract.

proposal_id.description: Unique id for this proposal (UUID recommended).

task_id.description: Round/task identifier this proposal answers. Mirrors the red input task_id.

prompt_version.description: Version of the red prompt template used to generate this proposal.

detection_under_test.description: The detection this benign scenario is designed to stress.

family.description: Permitted benign scenario family. Out-of-enum values are rejected locally.

workflow_steps.description: Bounded sequence of benign actions. 1..10 steps enforce the 'bounded' constraint.

expected_signal.description: Hypothesis about what in the detection this may trip. A hypothesis only, NOT a claim of results.

benign_justification.description: Why this workflow is legitimate/benign business activity.

evidence_references.description: Optional references to prior telemetry_evidence that motivated this proposal. References ONLY — red never embeds raw evidence.

constraints_ack.description: Explicit acknowledgement that red stayed within bounds. Red exposes no execution/judging capability.

rationale.description: Optional short reasoning for why this variation is a useful false-positive probe.

evidence_reference.description: Subset of the platform-owned telemetry_evidence contract that red is permitted to cite. See 00_shared_contracts/telemetry_evidence/.
